findings.statement: "The control plane must work offline" does not say whether a package registry may be reached during setup.
findings.why_it_matters: Two competent teams would build different products: one vendoring every dependency, one fetching at install time. The choice binds the distribution model.
findings.recommended_question: During first-time setup only, may DevCadence download dependencies from a package registry?

summary: One high-impact ambiguity about the meaning of "offline" remains unresolved.
